title: Pipelines: Free and Premium runners
description:
Bitbucket Pipelines Runners now operates under a two-tier model — Free runners and Premium runners — preserving a free tier for all workspaces while offering a high-performance Premium option for teams that need more concurrency, dedicated support, and advanced management features. Go to your workspace settings in Bitbucket Cloud.
	Select the Upgrade Runners button to open the configuration dialog.
	Choose Premium Runners and set your desired concurrency limit.
